title: Backtest Engine Core (Event-driven Orchestration with DI)
description: Refactor BacktestEngine into event-driven architecture with dependency injection. Orchestrates full pipeline: quintile sorting -> portfolio simulation -> metrics -> IC analysis -> attribution. Integrates with P1 TradingCalendar and P6 FactorEngine data contracts.

criteria: BacktestEngine accepts DI components: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_backtest_engine.py -p no:asyncio (exit code 0)
Full pipeline produces BacktestResult: verify by integration test
Legacy run_backtest() preserved: verify by backward compatibility test
TradingCalendar integration for rebalance dates: verify by calendar test
PIT data access enforced: verify by validation tests
convergence.definition_of_done: BacktestEngine orchestrates full pipeline with DI, produces frozen BacktestResult, preserves legacy interface

implementation.title: Implement BacktestRequest and refactored BacktestEngine
implementation.description: Create BacktestRequest frozen dataclass (factor_values DataFrame, forward_returns Series, config BacktestConfig, optional benchmark_returns). Refactor BacktestEngine with DI constructor accepting sorter, metrics_calc, ic_analyzer, attribution. Implement run() method: generate rebalance dates via TradingCalendar, for each date call sorter.sort(), simulate portfolio returns with CostModel, compute metrics via MetricsCalculator, optionally run ICAnalyzer and AttributionEngine, assemble frozen BacktestResult. Preserve legacy run_backtest() as wrapper.
modification_points: Create BacktestRequest frozen dataclass in engine.py
Refactor BacktestEngine.__init__() to accept DI components: sorter, metrics_calc, ic_analyzer, attribution
Implement run() method: full pipeline orchestration
Preserve legacy run_backtest() method as backward-compatible wrapper
logic_flow: Create BacktestRequest with factor_values, forward_returns, config, benchmark_returns
Implement run(): (1) generate rebalance dates, (2) for each date: sort -> simulate -> accumulate returns, (3) compute metrics, (4) compute IC, (5) compute attribution, (6) assemble BacktestResult
Add run_backtest() wrapper that creates default DI components and delegates to run()

implementation.title: Implement CostModel extraction
implementation.description: Extract transaction cost calculation from engine into CostModel class. Constructor accepts transaction_cost_bps and slippage_bps. compute_cost() takes old_positions, new_positions, total_stocks and returns cost as fraction of portfolio value.
